responsibility: This header provides the minimal C bridge that the GNU Modula-2 GCC frontend uses to refer to the runtime DynamicStrings abstraction without exposing its implementation. It defines the opaque dynamicstrings_string handle type and declares the small set of imported string-library entry points used elsewhere in the module, so it serves as a lightweight interoperability layer for search-path and runtime string values rather than a frontend tree- or code-generation facility.
